g.text: I study Data Science & Applications at IIT Madras,

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: co-enrolled at Scaler School of Technology, and I build LLM

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: systems, local desktop agents and full-stack products. Most

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: of the work goes into the layer around the model: rules that

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: can overrule it, retrieval that keeps it honest, consent

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: before it acts, and a way to undo.
